prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: supporting PBR BASE COLOR material trim sheet for three existing spaceship 3D models, NOT another ship rendering.
Input images 1-3 are palette and painted-surface style references only: Clean Slate ivory/teal, Second Wind moss green/cream/safety orange, Small Fortune rust red/cream/brass. Preserve this stylized industrial game art finish.
Produce a single flat 1536x1024 texture image divided EXACTLY into THREE 512-pixel wide equal columns with no gap or borders. Column 1 Clean Slate, column 2 Second Wind, column 3 Small Fortune.
Each column has FOUR equal-height horizontal 256-pixel rows, edge to edge:
ROW 1: field of painted hull armor, small subtle vertical and horizontal seams, restrained edge chips, screws, NOT large extruded objects. Ivory in column 1, moss green in column 2, rust red in column 3.
ROW 2: matching accent painted structural metal with restrained wear, fine longitudinal seams, small fasteners: deep teal in column 1, muted safety orange in column 2, warm cream in column 3.
ROW 3: dark glazed cockpit windows: continuous black teal glass strip with narrow metal upper/lower frame and evenly spaced narrow vertical mullions; dark teal and aged gold frames in 1, black charcoal glass and orange frames in 2, blue black glass and brass frames in 3. No bright white glare, just subtle cloudy reflections.
ROW 4: long narrow maintenance panels on matching hull paint, dark recessed service hatches, small vent grilles and fastening points. Ivory/teal in 1, moss/cream in 2, red/cream in 3.
Texture requirements: absolutely flat orthographic material scan, no perspective, no 3D bevel silhouette, no scene, no shadows from external objects, no ground, no global light gradient, no text, no logos, no labels, no background margins. All cells align to exact regular grid. Each cell fills its rectangle. Keep an even subdued painted material appearance so it works on model sidewalls. High-frequency scratches minimal, crisp useful panel lines. No whole ships, no engines, no people. Opaque image.
purpose: Supporting material strips for exposed walls, glazing and fittings with inadequate native reference coverage.
